title: DAY 5/90
SOM BEGINS
scenes.sub: Draw the circle, find the stress
scenes.voice: Day five of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and six days to GATE. Today we start Strength of Materials, a big scoring subject.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: New subject: Strength of Materials. Today's topic: stress, strain and Mohr's circle.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover stress and strain with the elastic constants, Poisson's ratio, Mohr's circle for plane stress and plane strain, and thermal stresses.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. The centre of Mohr's circle is the average normal stress. Its radius is the maximum in-plane shear stress. And E equals two G times one plus nu.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free practice set with step by step solutions is on Telegram now. Tonight's test runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 4 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day four toppers! Rank one, Atharva Vyas. Rank two, Akshay W. Rank three, Bhikya Naik. A tough test, and you led the way. Congratulations!
